title: Software Engineer - E-Commerce (Remote)
summary: New-graduate backend engineer developing scalable distributed services for a global e-commerce platform.
pros: Worldwide remote; Java is accepted; strong overlap with backend, SQL, microservices and system design.
cons: Listing is framed as new-grad despite an unusually high salary and generic recruiter copy.
notes: Seniority follows explicit New Grad wording; authenticity/details should be checked before applying.
candidate_fit_reason: Required coverage: 6 of 7 items are directly or substantially covered. Java, distributed backend systems, SQL/NoSQL, algorithms, system design and Git match; CI/CD depth is the main uncertainty. Weighted required coverage is about 84%.
